page_title: FRO 2-3 MON | Frosinone v Monza 06/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+3' The ball spins to Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
88' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) comes onto the pitch for Abdou Harroui.
84' Substitution. Mateus Lusuardi makes his way off the pitch and Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) comes on as his replacement.
81' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
77' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Pedro Pereira will be replaced by Samuele Birindelli (Monza).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dany Mota leaves the pitch and Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) comes on.
76' 2 - 3 Goal! Matias Soule (Frosinone) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Michele Di Gregorio to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
76' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is going to take the penalty!
76' Pierluigi Frattali (Frosinone) is shown a red card even though he is not on the pitch. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
74' What was Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
74' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) commits a rough challenge and Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows his whistle for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Frosinone.
73' The foul by Mateus Lusuardi (Frosinone) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Maria Ferrieri Caputi.
72' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
69' Monza are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
67' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) serves up a nice cross, but Michele Di Gregorio punches the ball away.
64' Pedro Pereira (Monza) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
63' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
60' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrea Colpani.
60' The substitution has been made. Pablo Mari (Monza) has replaced Roberto Gagliardini.
60' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) replaces Walid Cheddira.
56' 1 - 3 Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
55' 0 - 3 Own goal! Matias Soule (Frosinone) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:3.
54' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
51' Luca Caldirola (Monza) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Maria Ferrieri Caputi ignores the protests.
50' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
49' Monza are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.

48' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Michele Di Gregorio! Corner kick. Frosinone will have an opportunity.
46' Half-time substitution. Eusebio Di Francesco decided to make a change. Pol Lirola (Frosinone) is replaced by Giuseppe Caso.
46' The game is over for Reinier (Frosinone). Luca Mazzitelli comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+8' Frosinone keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
45+3' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi to decide. The relieved Monza players can finally celebrate.
45+2' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the goal using the VAR system.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' 0 - 2 Valentin Carboni (Monza) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets low into the middle of the goal.
43' Matias Soule (Frosinone) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
41' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Michele Di Gregorio (Monza) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Alessandro Sorrentino.
37' The game is interrupted now, Michele Di Gregorio (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Reinier (Frosinone) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
33' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.

33' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Michele Di Gregorio sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner. The referee points to the corner flag and Frosinone will take a corner.
32' Frosinone are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
31' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' Maria Ferrieri Caputi shows the yellow card to Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) for a heavy challenge.
28' The ball has crossed the sideline. Monza are taking a throw-in.
24' Reinier (Frosinone) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
23' The resulting set piece from Frosinone is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

22' Frosinone slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
18' 0 - 1 Dany Mota (Monza) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
18' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' A pass lands at the feet of Dany Mota (Monza) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Monza win a corner.
14' A cross into the box picks out Andrea Colpani (Monza), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
13' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
12' Pedro Pereira (Monza) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Pedro Pereira (Monza) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
9' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post.
7' Andrea Colpani (Monza) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just past the left post.
4' The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
1' Frosinone are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Maria Ferrieri Caputi was nominated as the referee for this game.
